name: Proton Drive
description: Proton Drive built into Spotty: sign in once, jump to trash, shared or photos, or search a synced folder
author: spotty
help:
Proton Drive, built into Spotty

Installing adds the `drive` trigger and a Proton Drive row under Settings → Search → Services and integrations. `drive` opens Proton Drive in Spotty's own Proton window, where you can browse, upload and download files (downloads go to your Downloads folder). `drive trash`, `drive shared`, `drive with-me`, `drive photos` and `drive devices` jump straight to those places.

Sign in once on Proton's own sign-in page inside that window. Spotty keeps the session in its private Proton web profile, shared with Proton Calendar and Proton Pass, so you stay signed in and any Proton app you install later finds you already signed in; Spotty never sees or stores your password.

Optionally pick a local folder you keep in sync with Proton Drive (for example with rclone); `drive <name>` then also searches file names in it. Spotty shows Proton's own web app using the system's WebKitGTK; without WebKitGTK it opens in your browser. Uninstalling removes the trigger only.
